title: Rank cyanate contributors
hints: Octets and charge magnitude are tied.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: O is more electronegative than N, so the comparable contributor with negative charge on O is preferred.
statement:
Two full-octet $\ce{OCN^-}$ contributors place the sole negative formal charge on O or on N. Which criterion favors the O-charged drawing?

[_]{a}

choices: N and O must trade places.
The negative charge disappears on O.
The O-charged drawing breaks the octet.
explanations: This favors assigning negative formal charge to O.
The total must be −1 in each contributor.
The prompt states that both satisfy octets.
